iOSReviewNotesPreparedOnly:
Scriptum is a native Markdown editor for iPhone and iPad. Local writing, organization and export do not require an account. iCloud synchronization is optional and uses the system iCloud account with CloudKit private/shared databases. No separate synchronization server is operated.

Build 12 corrects a reproduced local storage failure before synchronization: Foundation system-path normalization could retain an alias when Application Support did not yet exist. The strict no-follow outbox then rejected the path with Outbox.unsafeFile. Only the Foundation-provided app document/support roots are now POSIX-canonicalized before the existing descriptor-based checks. This does not reset documents, queues, credentials or cloud records, and does not weaken symlink, ownership, file-mode or atomic-write checks.

The exact old failure is reproduced in a permanent regression and an own iOS27.0 simulator fixture. The new production helper completes the real local outbox enqueue/reopen with byte-exact Unicode data. 806 tests execute successfully, four optional cases skip. This is not a claim of running on the reporting physical iPhone27.2.

Start with Spaces und Bibliothek öffnen. Use the cloud button in the page list or More > iCloud-Synchronisation, then iCloud aktivieren. A bounded error code and payload-free diagnosis are available if a service or local storage failure occurs.

Optional AI uses the selected provider and explicit context. Lektorat actions send only after Starten; direct chat edits are revision-bound and undoable. Apple PCC, ChatGPT sign-in and OpenAI/Anthropic API keys require their respective runtime/account eligibility. No advertising or tracking SDK. Experimental multilingual rule-engine research is excluded.
